run_merge_traj_main: run the merge_traj script with a root directory argument to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into full trajectories
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using the extract_file function
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP checkpoint files into a single full ASE trajectory file for an adsorbate run
read_vasp_xml_trajectory: read VASP XML trajectory files using ase.io.read with vasp-xml format and index slicing
write_ase_trajectory: write a merged ASE trajectory to a .traj file using ase.io.write for the full relaxation path
